containers.name: verify
command:
import sqlite3,json,pathlib,hashlib
root=pathlib.Path("/data/archives/ASTRA-pre-0053-20260905")
original=sqlite3.connect("file:"+str(root/"pharness.db")+"?mode=ro",uri=True)
changed=sqlite3.connect("file:/data/pharness.db?mode=ro",uri=True)
changed.execute("BEGIN")
assert changed.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0]=="ok"
versions=changed.execute("SELECT version,success FROM _sqlx_migrations ORDER BY version").fetchall()
assert len(versions)==53 and versions[-1]==(53,1) and all(v[1]==1 for v in versions)
assert changed.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM work_items WHERE workflow_policy_json IS NOT NULL OR workflow_policy_hash IS NOT NULL").fetchone()[0]==0
query="SELECT id,status,source_commit,closed_at,closure_reason,state_version FROM work_items ORDER BY id"
assert changed.execute(query).fetchall()==original.execute(query).fetchall()
controller_counts={t:changed.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM "+t).fetchone()[0] for t in ["hosted_reconciliations","hosted_operations","hosted_operation_locks"]}
assert all(v==0 for v in controller_counts.values())
counts={}
for table in ["work_items","runs","stage_executions","stage_outcomes","evidence_validations","audit_events","retention_holds","products","repositories","database_generations"]:
 a=original.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM "+table).fetchone()[0]
 b=changed.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM "+table).fetchone()[0]
 assert a==b,(table,a,b)
 counts[table]=b
assert changed.execute("SELECT * FROM database_generations").fetchall()==original.execute("SELECT * FROM database_generations").fetchall()
print(json.dumps({"integrity":"ok","maximum_migration":53,"applied_migrations":len(versions),"legacy_policy_rows":0,"historical_work_items_identical":True,"preserved_counts":counts,"controller_counts":controller_counts,"source_migration_unchanged":original.execute("SELECT max(version) FROM _sqlx_migrations").fetchone()[0]}))
